text.株式会社タイムレスリビング（以下、当社）は、個人情報保護の重要性を認識し、お客様: Timeless Living Co., Ltd. (hereafter “the Company”) recognises the importance of protecting personal information. The Company has established the following policy on the acquisition, use and management of personal information provided by customers, has made it known throughout its officers and staff, and observes it without exception.
text.個人情報の保護を実現し、お客様の権利利益を守ります。: To protect personal information and to safeguard the rights and interests of our customers.
text.当社は、不動産事業に関する個人情報の取扱いにつき、業務実態に応じた個人情報保護の: In handling personal information in connection with its property business, the Company has established a management structure for the protection of personal information appropriate to how it actually operates, and handles such information properly and carefully in accordance with internal rules.
text.個人情報を取得する際には、お客様に対し利用する目的を明確にし、その目的達成に必要: When acquiring personal information the Company makes the purpose of use clear to the customer, and uses lawful and fair means to the extent necessary to achieve that purpose. The purposes for which the Company uses personal information are as follows: the sales activities of the Company's business (visits, direct mail, approaches by telephone, approaches by email and the like); analysis of customer trends and research and analysis for product planning; and aftercare.
text.個人情報を利用する際には、あらかじめ公表している利用目的の範囲内のみで利用いたし: The Company uses personal information only within the scope of the purposes published in advance.
text.（3）個人情報の第三者への提供について: (3) Provision of personal information to third parties
text.当社では、お客様に提供／登録いただいた個人情報を、第三者に対して開示いたしません: The Company does not disclose to third parties the personal information customers provide or register, except in any of the following cases.
text.[2]当社と個人情報の保護に関する取り決めを行っている業務委託会社に対して、お客: [2] Where it is necessary to disclose personal information to a contractor with which the Company has an agreement on the protection of personal information, in order to carry out the purpose of collection stated to the customer.
text.[3]統計的なデータとして、お客様個人を識別できない状態に加工した場合。: [3] Where the information has been processed into statistical data in which an individual customer cannot be identified.
text.[4]行政機関から法的義務を伴う要請を受けた場合。: [4] Where a request carrying a legal obligation is received from a public authority.
text.個人情報の取扱いの全部又は一部を委託する場合は、委託先と機密保持を含む契約の締結: Where the handling of personal information is entrusted in whole or in part to a contractor, the Company concludes a contract including confidentiality provisions and exercises the necessary and appropriate supervision to ensure that the contractor manages personal information securely.
text.当社は、個人情報の正確性及び安全性を確保するために、情報セキュリティ対策をはじめ: To ensure the accuracy and security of personal information, the Company implements security measures, information security measures among them, and reliably prevents unauthorised access to personal information and its loss, destruction, alteration or leakage. Where improvement is found to be necessary as a result of internal audit, from instances of security incidents in the market, or from customer requests, the Company corrects the matter promptly.
text.当社は、確実な個人情報保護の実現のため、個人情報関連法令及び当社が加盟する団体の: To ensure the protection of personal information, the Company complies with the laws relating to personal information and with the guidelines of the bodies to which it belongs.
text.当社は、お客様の権利を尊重し、お客様から自己情報の開示、訂正・削除、または利用も: The Company respects the rights of its customers and will respond without fail where a customer requests disclosure, correction or deletion of their own information, or objects to its use or provision.
text.個人情報保護方針は当ウェブサイトの利用に際しても適用されます。当社は、当ウェブサ: This privacy policy applies to use of this website. The Company takes the greatest care over the handling of the personal information of customers who use this website, so that it is properly protected.
text.（1）お客様の個人情報が送受信される際のセキュリティのために、ＳＳＬによる暗号化: (1) To secure personal information while it is being sent and received, the Company uses SSL encrypted communication. Encrypting the information prevents its leakage or alteration. However, by the nature of the internet, security in transit cannot be guaranteed to be complete.
text.（2）当社は、当社のウェブページにリンクされている他のウェブサイトにおけるお客様: (2) The Company accepts no responsibility for the protection of customers' personal information on other websites linked from its own web pages.
